fields.summary: Checkout fails with HTTP 500 for orders without a coupon
fields.description:
Since the release deployed around 02:06 UTC, customers who check out without entering a coupon code get a generic 'Something went wrong' page. Support has received 14 complaints in the last hour.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Add any item to the cart
2. Go to checkout without entering a coupon code
3. Click Place Order

Expected: order is created and the payment page opens.
Actual: POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500.

Environment: production, checkout-service v1.4.1
Impact: roughly 40% of checkouts are failing; orders with a coupon still work.

comments.body: Reproduced on staging. The traceback points to calculate_total in pricing/discounts.py: order.coupon is None when no code is entered.
Error rate alert fired at 02:24. Rolling back checkout-service to the previous version now.
Root cause: commit 3087743 (discount refactor) removed the None check on order.coupon. Hotfix 2d10267 restores the guard and adds a regression test.
Verified on staging and production, no more 500 errors. Closing.

fields.summary: Orders accepted with zero or negative item quantity
fields.description:
While testing the mobile app I was able to add an item with quantity -3 and complete checkout. The order was created with a negative line total and the payment service later issued an automatic refund.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Send POST /api/cart/items with quantity -3
2. Proceed to checkout

Expected: request rejected with a validation error.
Actual: item accepted, order build fails later with 'negative line total'.

Environment: production v1.4.3

comments.body: validate_cart_item only checks that qty is not None. Zero and negative values are never rejected.
Please also block quantities above the per-item limit in the same change.
Fix 5da846a rejects qty <= 0 and adds tests for boundary values. Released in the next deployment.
Boundary cases pass: 0, -1, 1, max. Closing.

fields.summary: Order total does not match sum of line items (DB constraint violation)
fields.description:
Order creation fails intermittently with an IntegrityError on constraint ck_order_total_matches_items. About 1 in 10 orders is affected, mostly carts where the user changed an item quantity before checkout.

Observed in order-service logs: total=4999.00 but items_sum=5499.00.

Expected: total equals the sum of line items.
Environment: production v1.4.5

comments.body: The new code uses cart.cached_total, which is not refreshed after quantity updates.
The nightly reconciliation job also reported several mismatching orders.
Fix 1e3c29b computes the total from line items again. I also added a test that updates quantity before checkout.
Verified with quantity changes. Closing.

fields.summary: Invalid checkout payload returns 500 instead of 422
fields.description:
Sending a checkout request without shipping_address.postal_code returns HTTP 500. The API contract says validation errors must return 422 with a JSON error body. The mobile app shows a crash screen instead of a form error.

Expected: 422 with field errors.
Actual: 500 Internal Server Error.
Environment: production v1.4.7

comments.body: After the switch to pydantic models the handler still catches only ValueError, so ValidationError is unhandled.
Fix 3c8eb5b: handler now converts ValidationError to a 422 response with field-level errors.
Contract tests pass for all required fields.

fields.summary: Coupon discount applied multiple times after coupon refactor
fields.description:
Finance noticed orders where the discount is far larger than expected. A SAVE20 coupon on a cart with three items gave 600.00 off instead of 200.00, and some orders failed with 'discount exceeds subtotal'.

Steps: add three items, apply SAVE20, checkout.
Expected: 200.00 discount once per cart.
Actual: discount multiplied by number of items.
Environment: production v1.4.9

comments.body: The coupon engine refactor moved the coupon loop inside the item loop.
How many orders were affected? Finance needs the list.
41 orders in the window. Fix ec87a17 applies coupons once per cart; the list is attached.
Regression test added and passing.

fields.summary: Inventory goes negative under concurrent orders
fields.description:
During the flash sale several SKUs were oversold. Stock levels became negative and some orders could not be fulfilled.

Logs show 'Stock level became negative' with sku SKU-1042 and lost update suspicion.

Expected: stock never below zero.
Environment: production v1.4.11

comments.body: reserve_stock reads the stock and then writes stock - qty. Two requests can read the same value.
The row lock was removed in the contention optimization commit. Fix 6fce484 uses an atomic UPDATE with a stock >= qty guard.
Ran the 50-thread reservation test, no oversell.

fields.summary: All payments failing with 401 invalid API key after deployment
fields.description:
Right after the 07:22 deployment every payment attempt fails. Customers see 'Payment could not be processed'.

Logs show a warning that PAYMENT_API_KEY is not set and that PAYMENT_API_URL fell back to the sandbox default, followed by 401 from the provider.

Impact: 100% of payments failing.
Environment: production v1.4.13

comments.body: The new deployment manifest dropped PAYMENT_API_KEY. Restoring the secret now.
The settings loader silently accepts an empty key. Fix f21345d makes the service fail fast at startup if it is missing.
Payments are working again, thank you.

fields.summary: Payment gateway timeouts hang checkout requests
fields.description:
p99 latency for POST /api/checkout rose to 30 seconds and worker threads are saturated. payment-service logs show ReadTimeout from api.paygate.example.com.

The gateway status page reports partial degradation, but our service should not hang for 30 seconds.

Expected: fast failure with a clear error and retry.
Environment: production v1.4.15

comments.body: authorize() posts without a timeout and has no retry or error handling.
Fix 8a39d5e adds a 5s timeout, two retries with backoff, and returns a retryable error to checkout.
Worker pool usage back to normal.

fields.summary: Any logged-in user can view other users' orders
fields.description:
Security finding: GET /api/orders/{id} returns the order even if it belongs to another user. I changed the id in the URL and saw another customer's address and items. The security scanner also flagged sequential id enumeration.

Expected: 403 or 404 for orders that are not yours.
Environment: production v1.4.17

comments.body: The ownership check was dropped in the lookup simplification commit; there is a TODO left in get_order.
Blocked the enumerating IP at the gateway. We need to check access logs for earlier misuse.
Fix b50af03 enforces ownership and returns 404. Access log review attached to the security ticket.
Verified: other users' orders return 404.

fields.summary: Courier webhook crashes on malformed JSON or invalid date
fields.description:
The courier partner reports that delivery update webhooks fail with HTTP 500 for some payloads and keep retrying. Examples: truncated JSON body and a timestamp like 12/31/2026 25:00.

Expected: 400 with a clear error so the partner stops retrying invalid payloads.
Environment: production v1.4.19

comments.body: parse_event calls json.loads and strptime without handling errors.
Fix f244f58 validates payload and date format and returns 400. Added tests with malformed inputs.
Partner confirms the retry storm has stopped.

fields.summary: Orders list page very slow, database pool exhausted
fields.description:
Customers with many orders wait 5 to 9 seconds on 'My Orders'. Monitoring shows p95 latency of 4.8s and database connection pool usage above 90%.

Logs show one request executing 187 queries on order_items.

Expected: constant number of queries per request.
Environment: production v1.4.21

comments.body: Classic N+1: list_orders runs one query per order to load items.
Working on a joined query. Fix e3772a0 in review.
Pool usage dropped from 98% to 35% on the preview environment.

fields.summary: Payment webhook errors have no trace id, cannot correlate requests
fields.description:
When the payment webhook handler fails we get a log line without trace_id, so we cannot find the matching request in other services. It took two hours to link a failed webhook to an order.

Expected: every log entry carries a correlation id.
Environment: production v1.4.23

comments.body: The middleware sets the context only if the X-Correlation-ID header exists. Webhooks from the provider do not send it.
Fix 1a278f6 generates an id when the header is missing.
Confirmed in staging logs.

fields.summary: Invoice totals off by one paisa after money helper change
fields.description:
Finance reports invoices where the total differs from the line items by 0.01, for example 19.995 became 19.99 instead of 20.00. Some invoices failed validation.

A nightly test (test_rounding_half_up) is also failing on main.

Expected: round half up to two decimals.
Environment: production v1.4.25

comments.body: The helper now uses Python round() on a float, which rounds half to even and has float error.
Fix 3dbdde1 restores Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP.
Finance confirms the sample invoices are correct now.

fields.summary: Android app cart crashes: TypeError comparing str and int
fields.description:
Android app version 3.2.1 sends quantity as a string. The new maximum-quantity rule compares it with an integer, which raises TypeError and returns 500.

Steps: add an item from the Android app.
Expected: item added.
Actual: 500 on POST /api/cart/items.
Environment: production v1.4.27

comments.body: Payload quantity can be a string for older clients. We need to coerce before comparing.
Fix 6e4d58e coerces to int and returns 422 for non-numeric values.

fields.summary: Tax service unreachable in production after new tax engine rollout
fields.description:
Checkout fails with TaxServiceUnavailable. The new tax engine feature flag is on in production, but TAX_SERVICE_URL still points to the staging host (tax.staging.internal.example.com), which is not resolvable from production.

Impact: about 30% of checkouts fail (those with taxable items).
Environment: production v1.4.29

comments.body: The deployment config was copied from staging. Updating TAX_SERVICE_URL to the production host.
We need a startup check that rejects staging URLs in production.
Fix 75dff6c adds the config validation. Waiting for review.
